name: Toya Analysis Ontology v2
core_principle: Find the pattern. Search for what breaks it. Reconstruct why the data look that way. Only then model it.

core_rules.title: Schema is not truth
core_rules.check: Validate headers, value ranges, broken formulas, special codes and date encodings before analysis.

core_rules.title: Rows are not necessarily units
core_rules.check: Detect repeated measures, clusters, waves, periods, stages and IDs before treating observations as independent.

core_rules.title: Expected pattern to exception
core_rules.check: After finding a strong pattern, actively inspect observations that violate it.

core_rules.title: Reconstruct the data-generating process
core_rules.check: Infer protocol, selection rules, treatment timing, data provenance and latent constraints from observed structure.

core_rules.title: Can analyze is not should analyze
core_rules.check: Stop or simplify unstable models when events, units or variation are insufficient.

core_rules.title: Missingness may encode study design
core_rules.check: Check whether missingness varies by wave, period, treatment, stage or subgroup.

core_rules.title: Validate constructed scales
core_rules.check: For item batteries, inspect internal consistency and factor structure before using composite outcomes.

core_rules.title: Large N changes interpretation
core_rules.check: Prioritize effect sizes, uncertainty, incremental value and out-of-sample validation over p-values.

core_rules.title: Validation must match the target
core_rules.check: Choose random, temporal, group or country holdout based on where conclusions should generalize.

core_rules.title: The dataset may not contain the full question
core_rules.check: Identify missing variables, external data opportunities and theory-driven derived variables.

cautions: Do not random-split blindly when time matters.
Row count can overstate effective sample size.

questions: Do stated and revealed behavior diverge?
cautions: Do not overfit rare outcomes or interpret association as causation.
Validate scale quality before outcome modeling.

interpretation_rules: Separate statistical significance from substantive importance.
Report rare-event counts before model implications.
Distinguish row count from independent analytical-unit count.
Treat contradictions as potential evidence of hidden mechanisms or protocol rules.
End with the most decision-relevant takeaway and at most two next analyses.
